info.title: What is an Issue void?
info.body: Lets you cancel an Issue that was already recorded (for example, if something was charged or delivered by mistake). Any user can request it with a reason; the Accountant or M-BOS must approve or reject it. Once approved, the Issue is marked as voided and the stock that was deducted is automatically returned to the warehouse. This is always safe: it can never leave inventory negative.

stockAdjustment.title: Stock Adjustment

info.title: What is a Stock Adjustment?
info.body: Used to correct system stock when it doesn't match what's physically in the warehouse (after a count). For each product, you compare the current quantity against the counted quantity: if you counted more, the system automatically generates a Receipt for the difference; if you counted less, it automatically generates an Issue for the difference. Once saved, stock matches the count.

stockAdjustment.error: The adjustment could not be registered.

issueReturns.title: Returns

info.title: What is a Return?
info.body: Lets you return to the warehouse part or all of what was delivered in an already recorded Issue (for example, if the client returns products). You pick the original Issue and, for each product, enter how much is being returned; the system won't let you return more than what was issued minus what was already returned. Once saved, that quantity is added back to the warehouse stock.

issueReturns.issuedContext: {{quantity}} units went out on this issue.
issueReturns.exceedsReturnable: You cannot return more than what is returnable for {{product}}.
issueReturns.noLines: Enter at least one quantity to return.
issueReturns.error: The return could not be registered.

info.title: What is a Receipt void?
info.body: Lets you cancel a Receipt that was already recorded (for example, if it was entered by mistake). Any user can request it with a reason; the Accountant or M-BOS must approve or reject it. Once approved, the Receipt is marked as voided and the system deducts from the warehouse the stock that receipt had added. If part of that stock was already used by a later Issue or Transfer and there isn't enough left to reverse it, the void is automatically rejected so inventory is never left negative.
